text:
rachel: quick question  client asked if we can get a small travel advance for local expenses (SIM, taxis) while I'm on-site in Nairobi for a week. policy says advances possible but what's the exact process?
jon: you can request a cash advance via the Travel Request form. typical max is $200/day up to 50% of estimated OOPs. attach estimated line items. manager and finance must approve before funds are issued.
priya: note: for international advances we usually issue USD via payroll or bank transfer (not cash) to avoid carrying large local cash. finance will provide conversion guidance.
finance: process details: 1) Fill Travel Request -> select "Advance Requested" and enter amount + breakdown; 2) Manager approves; 3) Finance issues advance (ACH or payroll) within 3 business days; 4) Submit receipts within 10 business days of trip end or return unused funds. Failure to reconcile may offset against next paycheck.
rachel: ok good. what if some receipts are impossible (street vendors, tiny taxis)?
jon: for small local cash spends under $10 we accept itemized notes + bank/card screenshots where available. For anything > $75 missing receipt requires Lost Receipt Declaration (Confluence link).
priya: also remember VAT/tax treatment overseas: finance reimburses the net amount where VAT is recoverable only with invoice. If you paid cash, we reimburse the gross unless evidence shows VAT reclaimable.
finance: reminder: advances are not taxable if reconciled with receipts. Unreconciled advances may be treated as taxable income or payroll deduction per company policy.
travel-bot: automated: "Advance requests without travel request id will be rejected. Use Confluence template: Travel Requests -> Advanced Expenses."
rachel: last ones  how to return unused funds & timeline?
finance: return via bank transfer to the payment account used to send the advance, include Travel Req ID in memo. We expect returns within 10 business days after trip. Finance issues final reconciliation and closes the advance.
rachel: perfect. i'll submit Travel Req #9402 and request $350 for a week (SIM, taxis, local meals not covered by per-diem). thanks all :pray:
